about_the_game:
In Election Day, you decide who runs the government! Players take on the role of voters navigating a vibrant and ever-changing game board as they strive to make their voices heard in the zaniest election ever.

A new leader is elected each round, and their quirky policies transform the board. Depending on the whims of the current leader, tiles might grant unexpected bonuses, impose ridiculous penalties, or create wild scenarios.

Key Features:

-Every round elect a new leader that will change the board and mechanics based on their whims

-Choose the leader that will increase the odds of every player winning... Or the one that gets you on top!

-Avoid losing all your hearts! Or get taken to the hospital!

-Losing all your money means the overseer takes you out of the game... One way or another.
-Letting war take over the board is only good for the people with money already!

Work with other players or deceive them into thinking you are on Election Day!!!
